nodes.label: ADR 0004: v1 Payment Scope (Phases 0,1,2,3,6-lite,7)
nodes.contributor: rationale: v1 includes SaaS billing, Connect onboarding, one-time package purchase, ledger mirror, webhook idempotency. Deferred: recurring memberships, trainer split, audit UI, multi-currency, refund UI, Stripe Tax. Full scope rejected as taking 5-6 weeks vs 3.5 for first pilot.
